hooks.command:
# soft-foundry:guard
if [ -x exe/soft-foundry ] && [ -f lib/soft_foundry.rb ]; then ruby -Ilib exe/soft-foundry guard; elif command -v soft-foundry >/dev/null 2>&1; then soft-foundry guard; fi

# soft-foundry:guard-after
if [ -x exe/soft-foundry ] && [ -f lib/soft_foundry.rb ]; then ruby -Ilib exe/soft-foundry guard --after; elif command -v soft-foundry >/dev/null 2>&1; then soft-foundry guard --after; fi
